data.title: Waldorf Astoria Residences
data.about:
Introducing Waldorf Astoria Residences in Business Bay Dubai, a prestigious branded development by NABNI Real Estate Development. Set along the vibrant Marasi Drive, this exceptional tower rises 65 floors above ground and offers 2 to 7-bedroom residences, including Sky Mansions and Sky Villas. With interiors meticulously crafted by the renowned Hirsch Bedner Associates (HBA), each home embodies timeless sophistication and understated luxury.

Positioned in the heart of Business Bay, this iconic project reflects the Waldorf Astoria brand’s signature elegance and world-class living. Residents will enjoy an array of exclusive amenities, including serene swimming pools, a dedicated kids’ play area, outdoor yoga garden, spa, and more. Thoughtful leisure spaces such as a meditation deck, pool bar, and peacock alley complement the wellness offerings of a fully equipped fitness and yoga studio, golf simulator, and multifunctional lounge areas.

characteristics_module.title: Timeless Luxury in the Heart of Business Bay
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• First Fully Residential Waldorf Astoria Outside the U.S.: A rare opportunity to own a branded residence under one of the world’s most prestigious hospitality names.
  • Designed by Legendary Architect Carlos Ott:  A globally renowned designer known for creating architectural masterpieces around the world.
  • Iconic Location on Marasi Drive, Business Bay: Minutes from Burj Khalifa, with panoramic views of the skyline and Dubai Canal.
  • Exclusive Collection of 2 to 7 Bedroom Residences: Featuring signature apartments, duplex townhouses, sky villas, triplex mansions, and a bespoke sky palace.
  • Curated Interiors by HBA: Blending Art Deco and Art Nouveau influences with modern luxury and timeless finishes.

location_tile.title: Waldorf Astoria Enjoys a Prime Location in Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Waldorf Astoria Dubai Business Bay enjoys a prime position on Marasi Drive, minutes from Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) and Al Khail Road (E44). This strategic location ensures seamless access to the city's major commercial, residential, and leisure districts, offering residents the perfect balance between urban convenience and serene waterfront living.

  • Burj Khalifa – 5 minutes
  • Dubai Mall – 5 minutes
  • Dubai Opera – 6 minutes
  • Downtown Dubai – 5 minutes
  • City Walk – 10 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport (DXB) – 15 minutes
  • Coca-Cola Arena – 10 minutes
